scripts.install:apps: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.lint: node --check ecosystem.config.js && npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
